Who We Are

How We Deliver

Capability is what we can do. Capacity is what you pay for.

A permanent core, plus a vetted bench of specialist operators — camera, edit, colour, sound, motion — activated per job. Every piece, in-house or bench-sourced, passes the same quality gate before it carries the Catalyst 7 name. Who sits in a seat today never limits what we can take on.
